newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Baotou steel output 4.05 mln T in 1996.
newsitem.headline: China's Baotou steel output 4.05 mln T in 1996.

text.p: The Baotou Iron and Steel Co in China's Inner Mongolia produced 4.05 million tonnes of steel in 1996, the China Economic Times said in an edition seen in Beijing on Friday.
The output exceeded the official target by 750,000 tonnes, it said.
The company's post-tax profits reached 280 million yuan ($33.7 million) in 1996, with total sales reaching 9.6 billion yuan, it said.
It earned $94.77 million through exports in 1996, up 5.25 percent compared with 1995, it said.
The company faced tough market conditions in 1996 because of rising prices of coal, electricity, transportation and weak steel prices, it said.
An earthquake that rocked the region in May also affected its steel production, the newspaper said. Total economic losses to the company were estimated at 610 million yuan.
